s.t:
Du gibst dich nicht damit zufrieden, nur zu verwalten, was reinkommt, sondern willst als echter Hunter das Wachstum einer High-End-Agentur aktiv explodieren lassen? ✨ Als Business Development Manager (m/w/d) bei trafficdesign übernehmst du ab Tag 1 die volle Ownership für unsere Wachstumsziele!

Stumpfe Kaltakquise vom Fließband gibt es bei uns nicht – stattdessen bist du strategisch und voller Elan dafür verantwortlich, neue, kreative Wege zu entwickeln, wie wir potenzielle Partner erreichen und Leads organisch vorwärmen.

Sobald die Leads lauwarm durch Interaktionen oder Webinare bei dir landen, schaltest du auf Vorwärtsgang: Du entschlüsselst komplexe digitale Engpässe und verhandelst souverän auf C-Level. Wenn du hochgradig motiviert bist, Sales als strategische Spitzenleistung verstehst und das digitale Ökosystem im Schlaf beherrschst, ist das deine Arena! 🚀
Aufgaben
Wachstums-Verantwortung: Du trägst das volle Ownership für den Aufbau unserer Neukunden-Pipeline und treibst den gesamten Bereich New Business eigenverantwortlich und zielgerichtet voran.
Strategische Aktivierung: Du entwickelst und optimierst neue Wege und Kampagnen-Ansätze, um Zielkunden strategisch zu aktivieren und kontinuierlich hochwertige Leads zu generieren.
C-Level Beratung: Du nimmst die Inbound-Chancen mit hohem Elan entgegen, führst potenzielle Partner durch eine messerscharfe Pain-Point-Analyse und berätst absolut bedürfnisorientiert.
Mehrwert-Vertrieb: Wir verkaufen nicht um des Verkaufens willen, sondern bieten echten strategischen Support für die komplexen Herausforderungen internationaler Top-Brands.
Prozessmanagement: Du steuerst den Qualifizierungsprozess auf Entscheiderebene souverän und übergibst die Opportunities mit maximalem Kontext sauber an unser Closer-Team.
Qualifikation
Fundierte Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 1–2 Jahre (gern mehr) fundierte Praxis im Vertrieb, Business Development oder Consulting im Digital- oder Agenturumfeld mit.
Online-Marketing-Verständnis: Du verstehst das digitale Ökosystem im Detail, kennst die Hebel von Performance Marketing und sprichst auf Augenhöhe mit CMOs und CEOs.
Hunter-Mentalität: Du bist hochgradig motiviert, liebst das Gewinnen neuer Accounts und hast richtig Lust darauf, die Pipeline in Richtung unserer Wachstumsziele zu bewegen.
Souveränes Auftreten: Du trittst auf Entscheiderebene selbstbewusst, klar und kompetent auf und überzeugst durch echten Mehrwert statt durch Sales-Druck.
Analytisches Denken: Du liebst es, tief zu bohren, die wahren Schmerzpunkte von Unternehmen zu identifizieren und sie strategisch exzellent zu beraten.
Sprachskills: Du besitzt perfekte Deutschkenntnisse und sprichst gutes Englisch.
Werte & Kultur: Du fühlst dich von unseren Werten und unserer Unternehmenskultur angesprochen.

Performance mit Wertschätzung: Bei uns zählt beides! Wir sind laut Kununu seit 2022 die Nr. 1 der Agenturen in Köln – und 2026 der bestbewertete Arbeitgeber unter allen größeren Unternehmen . Erlebe offene Kommunikation, ehrliches Feedback und einen Vibe, der von Köln bis Hamburg wirkt 🩵
Volles Vertrauen: Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung im New Business von Anfang an selbstständig – wir geben dir klare Leitplanken vor, setzen aber voll auf dein Können statt auf Micromanagement.
Karriere-Boost: 1:1 Coaching, 1.500 € Upskilling-Budget + extra freie Tage für Seminare & Konferenzen🚀
Work-Life-Balance: Vertrauensarbeitszeit & von überall arbeiten – ob Office, Zuhause oder Beach-Vibes🏝️, du entscheidest!
Starke Kunden: Bei uns arbeitest du mit bekannten Brands wie Katjes, funny-frisch, ültje, Scania, Bübchen & JOOP! – spannende Projekte garantiert!
Feel-Good-Faktor: Kostenlose Massagen, Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft & höhenverstellbare Tische – damit du comfy arbeitest🧖
Nice Extras: Corporate Benefits, Essenszuschuss, Jobrad & Jobticket
Monatliche Events: Dachterrassen-Grillen, Spikeball, Charity-Runs oder die jährliche Skifreizeit (alles optional) 🏔️
Individuelles Teambudget: Jedes Team entscheidet selbst über eigene Erlebnisse (z.B. Bogenschießen oder schick essen)
Kult-Termine: Unsere legendären Events (Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier & Karneval) willst du nicht verpassen! 🤝
Bewirb dich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf dich!🩵

🚀 Key Account Executive (Outbound) (m/w/d) – Berlin (Vor Ort)
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt im Vertrieb bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden FinTechs weltweit?
Werde Teil unseres ambitionierten Teams in Berlin und unterstütze kleine Unternehmen im gesamten DACH-Markt mit modernen Payment- und POS-Lösungen.
Bei SumUp verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir helfen kleinen Unternehmen dabei, erfolgreich zu sein, indem wir Zahlungen einfach, zugänglich und unkompliziert machen.
Heute unterstützen wir bereits über 4 Millionen Händler in mehr als 30 Ländern – und wir wachsen weiter.
Als Account Executive (Outbound) übernimmst du den gesamten Sales Cycle und baust aktiv unseren Outbound-Vertrieb in Deutschland mit auf.
Du konzentrierst dich auf etablierte kleine Unternehmen (Upmarket SMBs) mit einem monatlichen Zahlungsvolumen von über 15.000 € und arbeitest als vertrauenswürdiger Berater, nicht als klassischer Produktverkäufer.
Diese neu geschaffene Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Prozesse mitzugestalten und den deutschen Markt aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.
🎯 Deine Aufgaben
Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
Proaktive Neukundengewinnung über Cold Calls, E-Mails und soziale Netzwerke.
Eigenständige Betreuung deines Vertriebsgebiets inklusive Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse.
Aufbau und Pflege einer hochwertigen Sales Pipeline.
Durchführung strukturierter Discovery- und Beratungsgespräche, um die Anforderungen der Kunden zu verstehen und passende Payment-, POS- und Kiosklösungen zu empfehlen.
Durchführung überzeugender Produktpräsentationen und Demos.
Souveräner Umgang mit Einwänden sowie Gespräche auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführerebene.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams wie Sales Enablement und Product.
Analyse deiner Performance, Erreichen deiner Ziele und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung anhand von Daten und Feedback.
Aktive Mitgestaltung einer leistungsorientierten Outbound-Vertriebskultur in unserem Berliner Büro.
👀 Das bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Outbound-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SMB- oder Upmarket-SMB-Umfeld.
Nachweisbare Erfolge im Full-Cycle Sales mit eigener Umsatzverantwortung.
Erfahrung in der Kaltakquise, Leadgenerierung und dem Aufbau einer Sales Pipeline.
Beratungsorientierter Vertriebsansatz sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexere Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen und passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
Deutsch auf C2- oder muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
Ausgeprägte Eigenmotivation, Hunter-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung.
Begeisterung für Technologie, Payment-Lösungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmern.
💥 Das bieten wir dir
Attraktives Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision – dein Erfolg bestimmt dein Einkommen.
Die Möglichkeit, bei einem schnell wachsenden globalen FinTech echten Einfluss zu nehmen.
Eine Office-First-Kultur in unserem Berliner Büro mit einem motivierten und internationalen Team.
2.000 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget für Kurse, Zertifizierungen und Workshops.
30 Tage Sabbatical nach drei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit.
Ein diverses und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden.
Ein attraktives Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm.
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
Wenn du im Outbound-Vertrieb erfolgreich sein möchtest, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Teil eines schnell wachsenden FinTechs werden willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
Bewirb dich jetzt und wachse gemeinsam mit SumUp in Berlin.
Job Application Tip
We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

About TEKA TEKA Group is a global leader in kitchen solutions, specializing in the design and manufacture of appliances, stainless steel sinks, and comprehensive kitchen systems. With a strong European heritage and a presence in over 100 countries, TEKA combines innovation, quality, and design to enhance everyday life at home.

As part of its global growth and expansion, TEKA has joined forces with Midea Group, one of the world’s leading technology and manufacturing companies. This strategic partnership strengthens TEKA’s global capabilities, innovation, and market reach, enabling it to offer increasingly advanced and competitive solutions on the international stage.

Driven by a commitment to functionality, performance, and design, TEKA continues to develop reliable products that bring efficiency and elegance to modern homes. A Senior Key Account Manager at Teka is responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with key clients or accounts.

They act as trusted advisors to key stakeholders, developing tailored solutions that drive profitability, strengthen market presence, and ensure exceptional customer satisfaction.

Working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, operations, and product teams, the Senior KAM delivers integrated strategies to achieve MIDEA’s business objectives and sustain competitive advantage in the market.

Responsibilities & Objectives Negotiation & Contract Management: Lead high-value contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements to maximize profitability and ensure sustainable business outcomes.

Client Relationship Management: Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with key clients, acting as the main point of contact for all their needs and inquiries. Revenue Growth: Identifying opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding product or service offerings to drive revenue growth within key accounts.

Customer Satisfaction: Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction by understanding clients' needs and proactively addressing any issues or concerns. Strategic Planning: Developing and implementing strategic account plans aligned with TEKA's business objectives to maximize the value delivered to key accounts.

Communication and Collaboration: Facilitating effective communication and collaboration between internal teams and key clients to ensure seamless delivery of products or services. Market Insights: Gathering market intelligence and staying abreast of industry trends to anticipate clients' evolving needs and provide proactive solutions.

Contract Negotiation: Negotiating contracts, pricing agreements, and service level agreements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes for both Teka and its key accounts. Performance Tracking: Monitoring and analyzing key account performance metrics to measure progress against objectives and identify areas for improvement.

Risk Management: Identifying and mitigating risks associated with key accounts to protect MIDEA's interests and ensure long-term sustainability of client relationships. Innovation and Value Proposition: Collaborating with key accounts to co-create innovative solutions that deliver unique value and maintain Teka's competitive edge in the market.

Collaboration with Internal Teams: Working closely with internal departments such as sales, marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure seamless coordination and delivery of solutions to key accounts.

Representing Teka: Actively representing Teka at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote brand visibility and expand the company's presence within key account networks. Among other duties as assigned. Qualifications Experience & Background +5 years of working experience in sales or related fields.

Home Appliance sales experience. Experience with key account management, including handling large accounts and complex sales cycles. Home appliances experience is a plus. Degree and Language Bachelor’s degreein business administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field is required. Advanced English is required.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Strategic Vision: Strong ability to develop and execute account strategies that align with organizational goals and deliver measurable growth.

Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are crucial for effectively conveying information, negotiating contracts, and building rapport with key clients.

Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills are needed to establish and maintain positive relationships with clients, understand their needs, and resolve any issues or conflicts that may arise.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms with key clients to achieve mutually beneficial agreements is essential for maximizing revenue and profitability.

Problem-Solving Skills: Being able to identify challenges, analyze root causes, and develop creative solutions is important for addressing client needs and ensuring customer satisfaction.

Sales and Business Acumen: Strong sales skills and business acumen are necessary for identifying sales opportunities, upselling/cross-selling products or services, and achieving sales targets within key accounts.

Customer Focus: Key Account Managers should be highly customer-focused, prioritizing the needs and interests of key clients and ensuring that Teka delivers value-added solutions to meet their requirements. Commercial Acumen: Deep understanding of market dynamics, pricing strategies, and business drivers within the consumer goods or appliance sector.

Organizational Skills: Effective organization and time management skills are important for managing multiple accounts, coordinating internal teams, and meeting deadlines.

Analytical Skills: The ability to analyze data, interpret trends, and draw insights from market research and account performance metrics is valuable for making informed decisions and developing effective account strategies.

Adaptability: Key Account Managers should be adaptable and flexible in responding to changing client needs, market dynamics, and business priorities.

Teamwork and Collaboration: Collaborating with internal teams such as sales, marketing, and product development is essential for delivering integrated solutions and ensuring a seamless customer experience.

Emotional Intelligence: Having high emotional intelligence enables Key Account Managers to empathize with clients, understand their perspectives, and build strong, trust-based relationships. Integrity & Professionalism: Upholds Teka’s ethical standards and acts as a brand ambassador in all business interactions.

Personal Traits Proactive: Key Account Managers should be proactive in anticipating client needs, identifying opportunities for growth, and addressing potential challenges before they escalate.

Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks and maintain composure under pressure is essential for navigating the complexities of managing key accounts. Empathy: Having empathy allows Key Account Managers to understand clients' perspectives, concerns, and priorities, fostering stronger relationships and trust.

Resourcefulness: Being resourceful enables Key Account Managers to find creative solutions to problems, leverage internal resources effectively, and adapt to changing circumstances. Tenacity: Key Account Managers often face obstacles and rejection in their pursuit of business opportunities.

Tenacity and persistence are crucial for overcoming these challenges and achieving success. Curiosity: Curiosity drives Key Account Managers to continuously seek knowledge about their clients' industries, market trends, and emerging technologies, enabling them to offer innovative solutions and stay ahead of the competition.

Adaptability: The ability to adapt to evolving client needs, market dynamics, and internal processes is essential for staying relevant and delivering value to key accounts. Optimism: Maintaining a positive outlook and attitude, even in the face of setbacks or challenges, helps Key Account Managers inspire confidence in clients and colleagues alike.

Integrity: Upholding high ethical standards and integrity is essential for building trust with clients and maintaining Teka’s reputation as a reliable and trustworthy partner. Team Player: Collaboration with internal teams is critical for delivering integrated solutions and ensuring a seamless customer experience.

Key Account Managers should be team players who can work effectively across departments to achieve common goals. Self-motivated and Comfortable in Dynamic, Fast-Moving Organization: Demonstrates initiative and adaptability in a rapidly changing environment, ensuring consistent performance and responsiveness to evolving demands.

What we offer: Benefits above those required by law Major medical insurance Food vouchers, among other benefits Disclaimer This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities. About DroneDeploy DroneDeploy powers field teams with robotics and AI. As the only reality capture platform that combines robotic automation, AI agents, and a truly unified system, DroneDeploy allows critical industries to operate with speed and confidence.

From construction and energy to agriculture, the world’s largest companies use DroneDeploy to simplify field operations, improve safety, and make smarter decisions, faster.

By combining aerial drones, 360 and fixed cameras, ground robots and proprietary AI, we’re bringing the power of automation and visual intelligence to all stakeholders, from the field to the boardroom. At DroneDeploy , we thrive in a mostly remote-first culture rooted in innovation and impact.

We’ve been recognized as a Best Place to Work in the SF Bay Area and named one of America’s Great Places to Work—but what truly sets us apart is the experience you gain: solving real-world challenges with cutting-edge technology, surrounded by teammates who are as passionate as they are supportive.

Our team is bold, mission-driven, and building something that matters. We foster a culture where a variety of perspectives drive smart decisions, and where growth—both personal and professional—is part of the journey.

Whether it’s flexible schedules, family-friendly benefits, or our strong track record of internal promotions, we invest in people as much as we do in product. If you’re looking to be part of something ambitious, authentic, and transformative, you’ll find your place at DroneDeploy .

This is an evergreen posting intended to collect interest from qualified candidates. It does not indicate that a specific position is currently open. Submitting your application is an expression of interest for future all Account Executive level opportunities at DroneDeploy .

Role Overview As an Account Executive, you will be a partner to organizations across our core industries, including Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC), Energy, and emerging markets. You will own a defined territory and/or portfolio of accounts, with a mandate to drive both expansion within existing customers and net‑new business.

This is a high‑impact, high‑autonomy role: you will shape account strategy, build stakeholder relationships, and deliver innovative solutions that redefine what’s possible in reality capture and field operations technology.

Beyond consistent quota attainment, success means navigating complex, consultative sales cycles, influencing multi‑stakeholder organizations, and leveraging cutting‑edge technology to drive measurable, real‑world outcomes. Work Environment > Work Model: Remote role based in the U.S.

(based within your assigned region and within reasonable proximity to a major airport). > Work Hours: Operate during standard business hours in your local time zone. > Work Travel: Be in the field 25%-50% of the time for client meetings, prospect visits, and company events; domestic travel is required, with occasional international travel as needed.

Responsibilities: Own and Drive Growth: Take ownership of your territory or book of business, developing and executing account strategies that deliver measurable revenue growth across expansion and new logo acquisition.

Account Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders ranging from project leaders to C‑level executives, uncovering business challenges and architecting tailored solutions that maximize value and impact.

Autonomous Decision-Making: Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing opportunities, structuring deals, and navigating complex negotiations. You will have the latitude to make critical decisions that shape both customer outcomes and DroneDeploy ’s market position.

Full Sales Lifecycle: Lead the entire customer journey—from prospecting and discovery through solution design, closing, onboarding, and ongoing expansion. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver seamless, high-value experiences for your clients.

Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry and technology trends in reality capture, AI, and field operations, positioning DroneDeploy as the partner of choice for digital transformation across AEC, Energy, and emerging industries.

Outcome Focus: Consistently achieve or exceed quota, maintaining a robust 120-day rolling forecast and delivering results that move the needle for both your clients and DroneDeploy . Requirements: We are open to sales professionals across multiple segments, including High Velocity, Mid-Market and Enterprise.

Ideal candidates bring 1 to 7+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets. Experience selling into AEC, Energy, or other field-based or emerging industries is strongly valued.

Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy, make high-stakes decisions, and deliver results in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments. Consultative, solution-oriented approach—skilled at uncovering needs, building consensus, and driving value at every stage of the sales cycle. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

Proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and an ability to quickly adopt new sales and AI tools. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Why Join DroneDeploy ? Impact: Shape the future of construction technology and leave your mark on iconic projects worldwide.

Autonomy: Be trusted to make strategic decisions, and drive outcomes that matter. Growth: Influence the rollout of new AI products and emerging technologies. Culture: Join a collaborative team that values innovation, initiative, and continuous learning. Flexibility: Work remotely, with the opportunity to be in the field 50%+.

Employee Offerings & Benefits (Benefits may vary by location and role) These are just some of the perks you'll enjoy—there's more to discover once you join us! Culture of Innovation & Collaboration – Thrive in an environment that values creativity and teamwork.

Drone Certification – Get certified and gain unique, hands-on skills with our full backing. Flexible Work Arrangements – Enjoy autonomy with remote-first options and schedule flexibility. Paid Family Leave – Take the time you need to support your family during life’s most important moments.

Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage – Plans designed to support your well-being. Career & Growth Development – Build new skills and unlock opportunities through continuous learning. Flexible PTO – Take time off when you need it to recharge—we trust you to manage your time well. Employee Referral Bonus – Know someone great?

Refer them and earn a bonus when they join our team. ---- DroneDeploy is an equal opportunity employer. All DroneDeploy employees are responsible for protecting the company and customer data by following information security policies and procedures.

Working collaboratively across divisions and functions, you'll develop and execute go-to-market strategies that expand our presence in the market and position Thermo Fisher as the partner of choice for biotechnology innovation.

Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company Our client is a fast-growing data privacy and AI company helping modern businesses build trust, reduce risk, and stay ahead of a rapidly changing regulatory landscape.

Its platform supports data privacy governance, data security and protection, consent management, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for sophisticated organizations that take customer data seriously. The Mission Our client is building its product for a world where privacy is no longer optional — it is a business imperative.

This team helps leading organizations protect customer data, meet evolving compliance requirements, and create stronger, more responsible digital experiences. The Opportunity This is a strong next-step role for an AE who has already shown they can sell SaaS and is ready for bigger opportunities, more ownership, and faster growth.

You’ll manage full-cycle sales, build pipeline through outbound effort, and sell into complex organizations where the stakes and learning curve are both high. What You’ll Do Develop and execute strategic sales plans to win new customers. Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and close.

Consistently meet or exceed quotas, targets, and KPIs. Conduct product demos and clearly communicate value to senior decision-makers, especially CIOs and CISOs. Partner with BDRs to qualify opportunities and build a robust pipeline. Maintain accurate CRM records and provide regular pipeline updates and forecasts.

What You Bring At least 2+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS AE experience with a proven track record of quota attainment. Ability to self-generate new business and build pipeline through consistent outbound activity. Experience selling complex technical SaaS in a consultative, solution-oriented way.

Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, plus a professional LinkedIn presence. Bachelor’s degree or higher from a U.S. institution. Ability and willingness to travel once per month to the company’s office.

Bonus: experience selling complex technical SaaS to CIOs, CISOs, and other senior technology or privacy leaders, plus familiarity with data privacy or cybersecurity. Key Success Drivers High ethical standards, honesty, and transparency in how you sell and how you work.

Strong self-discipline and self-motivation — you do not need constant supervision to perform at a high level. Hungry, energetic, and driven to win — you bring a hunter mentality to build your own pipeline and close business. Comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting quickly in a fast-moving startup environment.

Coachable, low-ego, and collaborative, with the confidence to contribute and the maturity to take feedback. Comfortable working with team members from diverse backgrounds and contributing to an inclusive culture. Why Join?

Competitive OTE in the $120,000–$160,000+ range, with an uncapped commission potential (top performers going higher and regularly outpace their targets) 100% paid medical, dental, and vision for employees — gold plan with zero out-of-pocket costs 401(k), life insurance, tuition reimbursement 2 weeks of paid vacation Generous President’s Club awards and company-paid events, celebrations, dinners Employer Highlights Profitable and bootstrapped — no VC pressure, sustainable growth Fortune 100 client base with patented AI technology No territory limits — sell wherever you find opportunity Sales-first culture with direct mentorship from the founder Interviewing Process (~2 weeks) Phone Interview with the Hiring Manager (General Fit) Video Interview with the Hiring Manager (Skills Assessment) Reference and background checks Offer extended to successful candidates We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

As we scale our portfolio toward 12,000+ units, we’re looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to build and drive the commercial engine of a dedicated cluster of properties.

This is a builder’s role: you’ll own a real P&L, spin up commercial projects from scratch — new B2B channels, GOPPAR optimization plays, OTA and SEM frameworks — and scale what works. The automated tech stack does the daily heavy lifting; you make the calls and build the playbook the rest of the portfolio will run on.
If you want to run a cluster like it’s your own — with the autonomy to test bold ideas and the data to prove they worked — read on.

s.h: How you’ll be hosting with heart
s.t:
Build & Scale Commercial Levers
Develop new commercial levers from zero to impact: GOPPAR optimization plays, personalized incentives, loyalty mechanics — test them on your cluster, measure hard, and scale what works across the portfolio
Build OTA product frameworks: crack where Preferred Partner, sponsored listings, visibility boosters and campaigns actually pay off — and turn it into a repeatable playbook
Run Ads experiments via sponsored listings: measure CAC against OTA commissions and steer spend to protect GOPPAR
Drive Local B2B Growth
Spin up local B2B as a demand-generation engine: identify, pitch and close the accounts that fill your cluster — corporates, hospitals, universities, contractors, event organizers
Build a non-OTA channel of direct stays you can activate whenever demand pacing needs a push; warm leads from the central B2B team are your head start, the pipeline and the results are yours
Own a Commercial Cluster to Test & Validate
Own commercial performance (RevPAR, GOPPAR) for a cluster of ~10 Limehome properties — your numbers, your calls and your playing field to solidify your ideas
Treat every lever — rate, channel, demand, cost — as something you can pull to move the bottom line
Cross-Functional Influence & Project Development
Develop, pilot and roll out new local growth initiatives end-to-end (e.g. personalized incentives, loyalty mechanics, local partnerships) – from idea to execution, without a ready-made playbook
Loop in central Channel Managers when your cluster needs a visibility push – OTA ads, content, campaigns
Quantify the commercial cost of ops, content or review-score issues and chase the right team to fix them — backed by numbers, not opinions
Flag the commercial impact of operational issues (e.g. a maintenance issue hurting your Booking.com score) so Ops can prioritize accordingly
4+ years in business development, commercial or revenue-driving roles : you’ve built and driven commercial initiatives, ideally in hospitality, serviced apartments, short-term rentals or travel-tech — though a strong commercial track record matters more than the sector
A builder’s mindset : you love taking an idea — a new sales channel, an SEM test, a pricing play — from zero to a measurable result, and you don’t wait to be told how
Commercially numerate : fluent with pricing, pacing and performance data; you measure everything and steer on evidence, not gut feel
Comfortable closing : when a project calls for outbound sales, you’ll pick up the phone and pitch — winning new business energizes you
Strong cross-functional operator : confident influencing without authority across Operations, Marketing and Distribution
Based in Munich or Berlin : this is a hybrid role out of our Munich HQ or Berlin office
Business fluency and English, German is a plus

Hospitality or travel-tech background : you understand occupancy, channels and how demand really moves
Comfort with an RMS / automated pricing : you’ve worked alongside pricing systems rather than doing manual data entry

Most business development roles hand you a target and a CRM. This one hands you a P&L and a blank canvas. You won’t just build a pipeline — you’ll build the commercial playbook for your cluster: the B2B channels, the OTA and SEM frameworks, the GOPPAR plays.

The automated stack handles the repetitive work; your job is to test bold commercial ideas, prove what works, and watch it scale. It’s a launchpad: this is the pilot for our new Commercial Owner model, so the frameworks you build here become the standard as we scale toward 2029. Build something — and grow with it.

Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office.
Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period.
Relocation Support : We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office.
Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas).
Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development.
Limitless learning : We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget.
Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly.
Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering.
Everything for our Limehomies : We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉

At Nuitée , we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”
By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.
With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.
Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.
Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

Nuitée is hiring a Key Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of demand-side accounts - fintechs, banks, super apps, and travel platforms that integrate Nuitée 's API to power their own products — across LATAM and NORAM, with full accountability for TTV, conversion, and revenue targets.
You'll act as the single point of ownership for everything that drives account performance, from technical adoption to commercial growth, working autonomously to identify, prioritise, and resolve whatever is getting in the way of an account scaling.
Nuitée has a large number of US-based demand partners onboarding, with a strong pipeline behind them. This hire is the first step toward properly covering LATAM and NORAM, as the Key Account team expands to 5 KAMs.
What makes it interesting
You own a portfolio end-to-end, with real autonomy from day one and no operational safety net telling you what to do next
You'll be driving one of the company's biggest growth bets. The growth happening in the US will have a major impact on the business, and you're the one leading that market on the ground
Your decisions and account management will meaningfully shape Nuitée 's broader commercial strategy in the region
Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, and was profitable already before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel. This role sits right at the center of that growth.
The kind of problems you'll work on
An account is approaching over-utilisation of their inventory feed, who flags it, and how fast can it get resolved before it becomes a client issue?
A client's growth is flattening, what does the data say, and what's the plan to get it moving again?
There's a clear upsell opportunity on an account, how do you own that commercial conversation and get it closed?
Supply and a client's needs aren't compatible, how do you coordinate internally to fix it before it becomes a churn risk?
Full ownership from onboarding to scaling demand partners
Manage a portfolio of customer accounts.
Build strong relationships with clients and understand their business needs.
Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and issues.
Coordinate with internal teams (sales, support, product, operations and engineering) to meet customer expectations.
Identify growth opportunities with the clients
Monitor customer satisfaction and resolve concerns proactively.
Track account performance to reach a consistent growth with clients
Role scope
The Americas KAM owns the full commercial and operational relationship with a defined portfolio of Strategic and Key demand-side accounts across LATAM and NORAM, from post-onboarding through to growth. This is a demand-side role — you'll be managing the platforms and businesses that consume Nuitée 's travel inventory via API, not the hotels or suppliers that provide it. In scope:
Full account ownership post-onboarding: performance, retention, and revenue growth
Participation in the onboarding process on a case-by-case basis, as determined by the Lead KAM based on account complexity and strategic importance
Revenue targets assigned progressively as the KAM ramps up and takes ownership of accounts
Upsell and cross-sell: identified and closed by the KAM directly
Close collaboration with Onboarding, Sales, Monitoring, and Product teams
This role fits someone who
Has 5+ years of experience managing accounts with ambitious, measurable revenue targets, and a track record of hitting them
Has strong analytical skills, able to independently interpret complex data, spot trends, and translate them into action without being told
Has experience with CRM tools (HubSpot is a plus)
Is proactive, comes with a plan rather than waiting for direction, and isn't afraid to pick up the phone and call a client directly
Is based in Latin America or the US, with full availability to cover LATAM and NORAM business hours (East and West Coast US)
Has native or near-native proficiency in both Spanish and English
Why Nuitee?
At Nuitée , we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.
Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée ’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.
By joining Nuitée , you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us— Nuitée is the place for you.

Position: Account Specialist, Affiliate Marketing
Location: UK or Germany
The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events.

As an   Account Specialist , you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.

Account & Client Communication
Build and maintain client and affiliate communications, including creative newsletters and updates about promotions, program developments, and general client information. Develop relationships with clients and partners to understand their goals and objectives, providing clear and proactive communication across channels.
Reporting & Data Management
Utilize Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.) to produce detailed reports, track performance, and analyze data for insights and trends. Summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations to optimize program performance. Proactively track key metrics and report on campaign performance.
Strategy Execution & Task Ownership
Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Prioritize tasks effectively, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Consistently leverage tools and client tracking platforms to support program goals.
Program & Portfolio Management
Manage multiple affiliate campaigns, maintaining a balanced focus across each, and organizing tasks by priority. Identify areas for process improvement, and provide proactive support to peers and clients. Manage risks, track fraud, and ensure compliance with program terms and conditions.
Team Collaboration & Growth
Collaborate with peers and management to contribute ideas for process improvements and training. Serve as a resource for peers and help drive continuous improvement across the team, sharing best practices and insights.

You will be proficient in the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs, including managing reporting, affiliate applications, recruitment, and creative asset deployment.
You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance, ensuring regular fraud checks and compliance.
You will have developed strong relationships with clients and affiliates and will be able to execute tasks with minimal guidance.

You will troubleshoot and resolve account and affiliate issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.
You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.
You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.

Confident and comfortable being uncomfortable
Flexible, resilient, coachable

Strong work ethic and personal standards

s.h: Senior Key Account Manager, Enterprise (Poland) About the Role
s.t:
At Uber, we don't just move people; we move the world. As a Senior Key Account Manager within our Enterprise team in Poland, you are the face of Uber Eats to our most significant marketplace partners. This isn't about maintaining a static portfolio or following a generic playbook-it's about navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script.
You will own the growth and success of a massive enterprise portfolio, shifting the conversation from everyday operations to true marketplace monetization.

This role is for a resilient, resourceful sales hunter who can confidently pitch retail media, map out high-stakes promotional campaigns, and translate raw data into a clear story of business growth.

If you're energized by the messy reality of doing big things and have the grit to close deals through genuine relationship-building, this is where you'll grow.

Drive Marketplace Monetization: Actively pitch, sell, and expand the footprint of advertising products (Ads) and promotional strategies (Offers) across your enterprise portfolio to accelerate partner growth.
Speak the Language of Benefits: Use data and advanced Excel modeling to build a clear financial story, showing partners exactly how much revenue they will unlock by investing in Uber's platform tools.
Build High-Impact Partnerships: Navigate complex client relationships to earn trust fast with C-level executives, moving beyond transactional accounts to become an indispensable strategic advisor.
Master the Sales Lifecycle: Manage your pipeline with urgency and discipline, adapting your approach based on fast-moving market dynamics, client needs, and imperfect information.
Resolve Objections with Grit: Confidently lead tough commercial negotiations, stay resilient through the inevitable \"no,\" and overcome client pushback by creating mutual, scalable value.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with operations, marketing, product, and legal teams to shape complex proposals, resolve partner blockers, and deliver marketplace solutions that scale.

5+ years of commercial experience in e-commerce, retail media, food-delivery marketplaces, or high-growth B2B sales environments.
Proven track record in active selling and account growth , specifically driving revenue through digital advertising, marketing solutions, or promotional campaigns.
Fluency in Polish and English (written and spoken).
Proficiency in commercial data analysis , including advanced Excel skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn metrics into persuasive sales narratives.

Customer Centricity: Strong emotional intelligence and communication skills, with an innate ability to adjust your style to connect with and influence C-level stakeholders.
Market & Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the Polish food-delivery or retail ecosystem, marketplace dynamics, and competitive landscapes.
Perseverance & Creativity: A \"go-get-it\" attitude with a track record of crafting creative deal structures and staying resilient through long, complex negotiation cycles.

Support Special Projects: Support various projects assigned by management to ensure continued development of skills.

You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads, which means the pitch has to work on its own merits rather than on brand recognition. This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle.

Run structured discovery calls solo, identifying pain and priorities for your primary buyer.
Close mid-market deals with negotiation support from the CRO as you build experience with more complex procurement.
Maintain your own weekly pipeline and forecast, developing commit accuracy over time.
Work SDR and Customer Success handoffs as directed, keeping CRM records clean and up to date.

3–5 years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, or a strong track record in an adjacent commercial role (for example SDR) ready to step up.
A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years.
Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them.
Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start.
Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked.
Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured.
Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance.
Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory.
What you'll get
Unlimited Holidays!
Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.
Enhanced maternity pay.

Private Healthcare (inc. dental, optical and hearing)

s.h: Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice
s.t:
Dog-friendly office .
Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.
About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.
That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

About Semarchy Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.
The RoleWe're hiring an Account Executive for our AMER Enterprise team. You'll own a full-cycle book of business, from qualifying inbound and self-sourced pipeline through discovery, solution development, demo, negotiation, and close. Our deals are consultative and multi-stakeholder: you're rarely selling to one person, and the technical conversation is usually a proxy for a business one underneath it.
Ownership doesn't end at signature. You'll build the account plan, hand off cleanly to Professional Services and Customer Success, and come back in to lead the commercial conversation when it's time to expand, renew, or move an existing customer onto our newly upgraded platform. Responsibilities

Build pipeline. Generate and qualify opportunities through inbound requests, closed-lost revisits, referrals, and your own outbound. Keep Salesforce and Gong current as deals move, not just at quarter-end, so your forecast holds up two months out.
Run discovery that gets past the ticket. Uncover the prospect's high-level company goals, bring company and industry context into the call, and get past the technical and personal pain to the real organizational stakes: what happens if nothing changes, and why that matters to the business.
Multi-thread the deal. Identify who else needs to be in the room and bring them in deliberately, rather than waiting for the prospect to volunteer them.
Shape the solution. Understand what the prospect thinks they need, and know when to introduce a requirement they haven't asked for yet, whether that's a related module or the specific reason we're the better fit against the alternative they're evaluating.
Partner with your SC on a demo that sells the pain, not the feature. Own the value narrative and coordinate the technical demo with your Solutions Consultant, who leads it. Tie what's shown back to what the prospect named in discovery, and give your SC the lead time they need to prep, especially when a demo gets booked with less than a day's notice.
Negotiate a real plan. Know which agreement you need next given where the deal actually is, and leave every call with a specific next step, a date, and a named owner on both sides.
Build a business case your champion can carry into their own organization, tied to the financial and operational impact you uncovered together.
Manage the process to close, tracking the paper, security review, and approvals that sit between a verbal yes and a signature.
Own the account plan and the handoff. Build the plan for your named accounts, lead a clean handoff to Professional Services and Customer Success at close, and stay the commercial owner for expansion, renewal, and platform-transition conversations in your book.

A track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder software deals, ideally in data, analytics, or platform categories.
Comfort running a structured sales process while staying present and conversational. The framework should make the conversation feel more natural, not scripted.
Directness balanced with warmth. You can name a stalled buy-in or an unrealistic timeline out loud, in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
Genuine curiosity about the prospect's business, not just their tech stack. You ask a second and third “why,” and you're comfortable letting a call go somewhere your outline didn't predict.
Coachability. You take feedback, apply it, and can name your own gaps before someone else does.
A collaborative style, especially with your SC. You don't need deep technical fluency on day one; you need the instinct to loop your SC in early and work the deal together, not around them. You also bring in deal desk, partners, and leadership early.
Ownership. You flag a deal risk before it becomes a surprise, and you show up with a plan alongside it.
Judgment about where your time goes. With a growing book, you know which two or three accounts genuinely need you this week and protect the rest of your time for the next deal.

Experience selling into Snowflake or Databricks ecosystems.
Familiarity with MDM, data governance, or data quality, or the track record to get there fast.
Experience competing against vendors like Informatica or Reltio.

We are committed to making Semarchy an even better place to work, and this means creating a high performing environment where everyone can do their Best Work, where they can Grow in their career path, and Be Accountable – to each other and Semarchy .

Abacus ist fast schon das Microsoft der Schweiz. Über 60’000 KMU setzen auf die ERP\-Lösung aus St. Gallen – und immer mehr davon auch auf integrierte Data\- \& Analytics\-Lösungen, um Transparenz, Steuerung und Effizienz zu erhöhen. AXEPT gehört zu den führenden Abacus\-Partnern und unterstützt Kunden dabei, ihre Daten gezielt nutzbar zu machen. Unser Data\-\&\-Analytics\-Bereich wächst stark – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.
**Das macht deinen Alltag spannend:**
* Gewinnung neuer Kunden und Projekte im Bereich Data\-, Reporting\- und Analytics\-Lösungen rund um Abacus und andere Lösungen
* Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Priorisierung von Leads sowie eigenständiger Aufbau und Pflege der Sales\-Pipeline
* Ganzheitliche Steuerung des Vertriebsprozesses von der Erstansprache über Präsentationen und Angebotsverhandlungen bis zum Abschluss
* Analyse der Kundenanforderungen im Bereich Reporting, Controlling und Analytics und Entwicklung passender Lösungskonzepte
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams wie D\&A\-Team, Sales\-Team, Projects, Product \& Innovation sowie Backoffice zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
* Beobachtung von Markt\- und Technologietrends im Bereich Data \& Analytics und aktive Weitergabe im Sales\-Team
**Das bringst du mit:**
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management, Consulting oder Lösungsverkauf – idealerweise im Data\-, Analytics\- oder Software\-Umfeld
* Freude an aktiver Neukundenakquisition und am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
* Ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, KPIs und Reporting\-Anforderungen
* Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Daten\-Themen verständlich zu erklären
* Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten
* Unternehmerisches Denken und den Anspruch, deine Umsatzziele eigenständig zu erreichen
* Starkes Interesse an Data, Analytics, BI und Digitalisierung
* Kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung – kombiniert mit Erfahrung in Beratung oder Verkauf
* Kenntnisse von Abacus, BI\-Tools oder Reporting\-Lösungen sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
**Und das hast du dann davon:**
* Einen anspruchsvollen, aber superspannenden Job, in den wir dich vor Ort gut einarbeiten. Und wenn du sattelfest bist, gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
* Es ist uns ein wenig peinlich, uns für den vermutlich besten Teamspirit weit und breit selber zu rühmen. Darum zitieren wir hier einfach ein fünf Sterne\-Feedback von Kununu: «Teamspirit wird gross geschrieben». Stimmt!
* Von null auf hundert in 19… nein, nicht Sekunden, Jahren. Wir sind schnell, aber gesund gewachsen und gut organisiert. Doch etwas ist noch wie in unseren Anfängen: Die Strukturen sind schlank und du findest die richtigen Ansprechpartner leicht.
* In unserem Bereich gehören wir zu den grösseren Playern und sind bekannt für unsere hohe Qualität. Kein Wunder, werden wir immer wieder als herausragend guter Umsetzungspartner ausgezeichnet.
* Einen guten Lohn, den du mit deiner Leistung mitbestimmen kannst. Krankentaggeld\- und Unfallversicherung? Übernehmen wir. Zusammen mit anderen Benefits macht das schnell einmal ein paar Tausender im Jahr aus.
**Schon Feuer gefangen?** Du willst lieber heute als morgen loslegen? Dann schick uns dein CV oder den Link zu deinem LinkedIn\-Profil. Das Motivationsschreiben kannst du dir sparen, wir sind auch da völlig unkompliziert.
**Und das (a) im Stellentitel?** Es ist unser Statement für Vielfalt. Wir stehen auf durchmischte Teams. Alter, Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Geschlecht oder Lebensentwurf sind uns egal. Bei uns sind **(a)**lle willkommen, die uns mit ihrem Talent weiterbringen.

From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. Navitus Health Solutions is seeking a Sr. Account Executive to join our team!
The Sr. Account Executive (Sr. AE) is a senior level individual contributor responsible for full strategic ownership of complex client accounts within the health plan and employer PBM space.

This role leads sophisticated client relationships and books of broker, consultants and/or TPA Agents, serving as the primary strategic partner for Company level clients with high customization, elevated service needs, and complex benefit designs. The Sr.

Account Executive independently manages account strategy, resolves complex situations, leads Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and engages executive level client and consultant stakeholders while collaborating closely with internal partners including Sales, Clinical Account Executives, Analytics, Operations, and Product teams.
This position plays a critical role in advancing organizational goals for the organization by strengthening long‑term client partnerships, increasing adoption of value‑added programs, and ensuring solutions are aligned with evolving clinical, financial, and utilization trends.

Through strategic insight, professional influence, and mentorship of other Account Executives, the Sr. Account Executive helps elevate client outcomes, reinforces the Company differentiation in the marketplace, and supports sustainable growth across complex client segments.
Is this you? Find out more below!

How do I make an impact on my team?
Lead full strategic ownership of a highly complex book of business, including employer groups, health plans, and multi consultant relationships, ensuring long-term alignment with organizational objectives.
Direct client account strategy, including planning, execution, and ongoing refinement based on clinical trends, utilization data, and business insights.
Maintain trusted executive‑level relationships with clients, brokers, and consultants by demonstrating strong listening skills, professional judgment, and the ability to influence outcomes aligned with both client and company priorities.
Guide Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) by setting agendas, coordinating cross‑functional preparation, leading pre‑review planning sessions, and delivering customized insights and recommendations.
Upsell value added programs such as AGS, medical carveouts with Archimedes products, and clinical program offerings into client strategies based on identified needs and opportunities.
Translate complex reporting, claims adjudication concepts, and clinical insights into actionable recommendations, identifying root causes of performance gaps across the end‑to‑end process.
Resolve complex client issues independently by applying deep operational, contractual, and clinical knowledge, while exercising appropriate judgment on when escalation is necessary.
Mentor Account Executives team members by sharing best practices, producing training materials, and leading internal task forces or workgroups.

What our team expects from you?
Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required.
5-7 years of progressive experience leading highly complex client accounts within the PBM, health plan, healthcare, or related benefits environment, including responsibility for overall account strategy, performance, and retention required.
5 years of demonstrated success managing executive‑level client, broker, and consultant relationships, involving significant customization, financial impact, and strategic oversight required.
5 years of experience leading Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other strategic client engagements that address clinical trends, financial outcomes, utilization patterns, and performance guarantees required.
5 years of experience independently resolving complex account issues, applying sound judgment to determine when escalation is necessary versus when issues can be resolved without leadership involvement required.
5 years of experience mentoring peers and contributing to formal or informal training, task forces, workgroups, or cross‑functional initiatives that improve client outcomes or operational effectiveness required.
5 years of working knowledge of claims adjudication processes, including the ability to assess downstream impacts on client experience, financial outcomes, and clinical program performance required.
